course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice making a short everyday summary with därför.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Wrapping up a week at work or explaining why a plan changed.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Connecting an everyday reason to a result in a concise way.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik summarize a busy week and explain why they want a calm weekend.

main_focus.name: result connector därför
main_focus.description: Use därför to connect a reason to a result while keeping Swedish V2 word order after the connector.
model_examples: Veckan var intensiv, därför vill jag vila i helgen.
Det blev sent igår, därför är jag trött idag.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use därför naturally 2-3 times, with correct verb placement after därför.

useful_chunks: Därför vill jag ta det lugnt.
För det mesta gick det bra.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use the summary chunks to make the conversation feel like a real Friday check-in.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how the week has been.
dialogue_shape.middle: They mention two events or pressures and connect reasons to results with därför.
dialogue_shape.ending: They describe a realistic plan for resting or catching up.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat därför enough to reinforce V2 without sounding artificial

focus: the overall feeling about the week
the reason for wanting a calm weekend
what weekend plan or outcome is chosen

sentence_focus: one sentence with därför after a reason
one sentence about an intensive week
one sentence using ta det lugnt
one sentence with för det mesta
one sentence combining a past event with a present result
